name: BL-03
description: A permission error must not leak an internal sub-corpus id (enumeration oracle)
descriptionHtml: A permission error must not leak an internal sub-corpus id (enumeration oracle)
statusMessage: The response to a submission under a foreign-owned ABN leaked an internal identifier (HTTP 500 — {"statusCode":500,"message":"One or more errors occurred!","errors":{"generalErrors":["User does not have 'Contributor' permission on existing sub-corpus 'StorageFacility-53004085616' (ID=1943)."]}}). That makes the endpoint an ABN enumeration oracle — see bug 10581. This guard passes once the id is removed from the error body. expected [false] but found [true]
